answer_1.quote: We present Knowledge-aware Large Multimodal Assistant (KaLMA) for addressing Text-KVQA. The KaLMA is an effective architecture that seamlessly integrates questions and images in the context of external knowledge in a trainable architecture to generate accurate answers.
answer_1.outputs: answers to visual questions based on text in images and external knowledge
